summary: Build the Subactor ecosystem Digital Twin

delivery.outcome: Publish a private, read-only ecosystem Digital Twin that discovers all configured repositories, projects source health and emits digest-bound next-action candidates without acquiring execution authority.
nonGoals: No second scheduler, controller or event-store authority
No repository mutation, stash handling, secret intake or repair apply
No direct PR approval or merge decision
No inference that an unavailable source is healthy
No semantic ownership inferred from repository name alone

architecture.decision: Build one read-only projector over bounded repository and Control adapters. Persist only rebuildable snapshots. Emit advisory handoff candidates bound to content digests; leave scheduling and all effects in existing Subactor runtimes.
dataChanges: Rebuildable snapshot files contain hashes and source metadata but no credentials
architecture.rollback: Remove the service registration and repository; no external system state is owned by the Twin

validation.evidence: Deterministic discovery, freshness, deduplication and handoff tests pass
Read-only non-root runtime profile builds and scans mounted sources
Governance and stack checks pass on the exact head
